brand.name: PEAK
brand.name_note: Display name in all new copy and labels is 'PEAK' -- never 'Peak Saunas'. Models by their own names (e.g. 'Patagonia', never 'Mont Blanc'); 'Smart Life app', never 'Peak Saunas app'; no 'WiFi' in titles. Domain, email, URL/product handles and the legal entity line (Peak Wellness USA LLC) are unchanged.
brand.applied: 2026-10-05 (cycle 78), boxless layer 2026-10-05 (cycle 79, owner-approved round 2/3 design). Replaces the 2026-09-22 rebrand palette (cycle 52); the owner banned all orange on 2026-09-28.
color.hairline: rgba(22,24,23,.14) (section rules, list rows); borders rgba(22,24,23,.18)
color.role.forbidden: no orange (#F37047/#F27046), no green/cyan (#16C47F/#11BDFB), no cream (#EFE8DA/#EFE3D2), no stone (#F0E5D3), no grey panels (#F1F1F1/#F2F2F2), no sage (#C0C8C3/#BFC6C1), no cedar (#483215); no gradients, glows or drop shadows
color.background.panel: none (cycle 79): sections separate by white space and one hairline
color.button.primary: pill, radius 999px, padding 17px 44px, Poppins 600 16px; Basalt fill + white text on light grounds, white fill + Basalt text on dark/photo grounds; hover red #702B34 with white text; optional arrow after the label
color.button.buy_box: Basalt, white text, radius 4px, min-height 56px, full width
color.button.secondary: transparent, 1.5px solid #1A1A1A, #1A1A1A text; hover fills #1A1A1A with white text
color.badge.best_seller: white fill, #712B33 text, 1px rgba(113,43,51,.35) border, wave icon + 'Best Seller'
color.price.savings_pill: '$X total savings', red text, no fill
font.label: DM Sans 11-12px uppercase, letter-spacing .16-.26em, #6B6B6B
font.loading: DM Sans and Poppins are loaded site-wide by the storefront theme; the review page loads them from Google Fonts (tenant.yaml brand.font_stylesheet). The two display faces are @font-face rules in base.css with absolute theme-CDN URLs, carried into the export.
shape.radius_box: 4px on any remaining box, card, input or photo
shape.card: image on white, no plate, no shadow
shape.dark_band: one Basalt closing band per page, white text, white pill CTA
logo.theme_marks: wave icon + PEAK wordmark (Basalt), pk-icon-white.png, pk-logotype-white.png, pk-logo-red.png -- on the live theme, not in this repo
logo.never: the legacy green/cyan mountain 'Peak Saunas' mark, or photos showing the white mountain + 'Peak Saunas' on sauna glass above the fold (photo-library.json tags.old_logo_visible). Exception (owner, 2026-10-05, for now): the product cut-outs in brand/cutouts/ carry the old mark and are used in every generation
layout.bottom_clearance_note: Every storefront page carries the Peak Assist bar (~70px), a sales popup bottom-left and Klaviyo -- no sticky CTA at the bottom edge.
color.accent_phrase: #702B34 -- one phrase of the headline, numerals, the 3px proof/stat bar
font.display.wide: Peak Grotesk Wide, UPPERCASE, the 'display' first screen (owner-approved 2026-10-05); https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0825/8312/6317/t/64/assets/pk-peak-grotesk-wide.woff2
font.display.acid: Acid Grotesk, sentence case, alternative display face (owner-approved 2026-10-05; file labelled TRIAL -- confirm commercial licence); https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0825/8312/6317/t/64/assets/pk-acid-grotesk-trial.otf
shape.boxes: cycle 79: no boxes for trust, byline, proof lines, audience fit or FAQ; proof lines and stats get a 3px brand-red left bar; FAQ is plain Q and A on hairlines (no accordion)
layout.first_screen: cycle 79: three approved first screens -- face (ad still + verbatim quote), story (text-first open-loop lede), display (wide display face, product cut-out, stats strip); harness/first_screen.py
product.cutouts: cycle 79: the owner's product cut-outs (old mark, accepted for now) in brand/cutouts/, manifest brand/cutouts/cutouts.json; product hero and per-model images use them
